release_boundary: v1 source-supported methodology layer. 'ruled' means an operational source-backed rule exists. It does not mean expert-benchmark validation or runtime execution is complete.

statuses.registered: Relevant source family is present in the corpus.
statuses.extracted: Source-grounded evidence has been extracted but the operational rule is incomplete.
statuses.ruled: At least one source-supported operational Methodome rule exists.
statuses.deferred: Intentionally outside the v1 autonomous recommendation/execution boundary.
statuses.gap: Insufficient source support for even a conservative v1 rule.

domains.notes: Description, association/explanation, prediction, causal, diagnostic, prognostic/ time-to-event, qualitative and exploratory routing are represented at the intent/gating layer.

Cross-sectional, cohort, case-control, randomized experiment, longitudinal/repeated, cluster-aware, interrupted time-series and mixed-method design gates are represented. Ecological-study-specific inference remains an expansion item.

Simple random, systematic, stratified, cluster, multistage, PPS-oriented design metadata, census/complete enumeration, probability versus non-probability sampling, weights, strata, PSU and domain analysis are represented. Purposive sampling is treated under the non-probability boundary rather than design-based survey inference.
Binary, nominal, ordinal, quantitative, count and time-to-event roles are represented sufficiently for v1 routing.
Categorical count/proportion summaries and quantitative centre/spread choices by shape and outliers are represented.
Independent/Welch and paired t routing is represented without a universal n>=30 threshold.
Wilcoxon signed-rank, Mann-Whitney/Wilcoxon rank-sum interpretation, and Kruskal-Wallis routing are represented with explicit anti-shortcut safeguards.
Design-aware one-way fixed-effect ANOVA routing and residual diagnostics are represented; repeated/random/clustered structures are blocked from ordinary ANOVA.
Categorical eligibility and expected-count approximation checks are represented.
Exact independent 2x2 routing for sparse tables is source-backed without an arbitrary total-sample threshold.
Linear quantitative association and graphical/outlier diagnostics are represented.
Ordinal/ranked and monotonic rank-association routing is source-backed; no automatic normality-test switch is allowed.
Outcome eligibility, LINE assumptions, residual diagnostics and multicollinearity checks are represented.
Binary-response eligibility, fit/residual diagnostics, separation safeguards and sparse-event safeguards are represented; Firth remains non-executable.
Nominal versus ordinal response routing is source-backed. Model-specific assumptions/diagnostics remain outside autonomous execution.

Count-response and overdispersion principles are source-backed, including the prohibition on automatic overdispersion→negative-binomial switching. Detailed NB/zero-inflated/hurdle automation is deferred and non-executable.
Within-unit dependence is a hard gate; marginal GEE versus subject-specific mixed-model interpretation is represented conceptually.
Clustering changes inference and blocks iid methods; exact small-cluster corrections and future executors remain expansion work.
Weights, strata and PSU/cluster design must travel together into variance estimation; domain/subpopulation analysis preserves design context.

No automatic complete-case default, no percentage-missing threshold for MI, missingness-mechanism review, sensitivity analysis, MICE model/pooling/diagnostic safeguards and multilevel-imputation structure are represented.

Causal identification gate requires intervention/exposure, estimand, exchangeability, positivity and consistency; difference-in-differences parallel-trends logic is represented. Advanced estimator-specific routing remains expansion work.
Pretrend, interruption timing, level/slope changes and autocorrelation are represented; simple pre/post analysis is blocked.
Censoring-aware survival routing and competing-risk gating are represented; recurrent-event/frailty workflows remain future expansion.
Reference-standard 2x2 structure, sensitivity, specificity, predictive values, likelihood ratios and threshold/ROC behaviour are represented; runtime execution remains outside v1.
Prediction versus explanation, discrimination, calibration, overfitting and validation are represented; full prognostic modelling workflow remains expansion work.
Reflective versus formative gate, structural validity before internal consistency, and reliability versus measurement-error separation are represented. Full factor/invariance executors are deferred.
Qualitative objectives are recognized and blocked from inappropriate quantitative routing, but autonomous coding/thematic-analysis rules are outside v1.
Convergent and sequential integration designs are represented separately from the quantitative statistical design.
Prespecification, primary-variable definition, analysis sets, missing-data plan, multiplicity, covariates/subgroups and sensitivity analyses are represented for SAP construction/locking.
Method-specific diagnostics are represented for current simple methods plus ANOVA, logistic separation/sparsity and MICE safeguards; future executors add their own diagnostics.
Source-backed reporting rules cover observational studies, randomized trials, diagnostic accuracy and prediction models; reporting guidance is kept separate from method selection.
Outside the v1 autonomous analysis boundary.
Advanced SEM/CFA/IRT execution is outside v1 despite psychometric routing safeguards.
